title: Specification for Radio Frequency Connectors of BNC, TNC AND UHF Series, Part 2: BNC Series, Section 3: Plug, Right Angle, Cabled Type 11075 IS-03-01 to 02 and 50 to 51
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11075 (PART 2)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Specification for Radio Frequency Connectors of BNC, TNC AND UHF Series, Part 2: BNC Series, Section 3: Plug, Right Angle, Cabled Type 11075 IS-03-01 to 02 and 50 to 51.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Free Cutting Brass Bars, Rods and Section
Leaded brass strips for instrument parts

clause_3_terminology: Specification for Radio Frequency Connectors of BNC

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
